name: cadre
status: v0 works and I use it
description: A provider-neutral engine for multi-model agent fleets. Hand a task to several specialist agents, each with its own model and tools, then merge what they find.

name: agent-os
description: A local-first control plane and shared brain that lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and my other agents work as one team instead of strangers.

name: agent-brain
description: Shared memory across agent tools. Raw notes go in; only reviewed knowledge gets promoted to "truth."

name: agent-cost-tracker
description: A small app for tracking AI tool subscriptions, built as an experiment: planned in Claude Code, built in Codex, QA'd in Cursor, with every rough edge logged.

name: devils-advocate
description: A Claude Code plugin that has models from different providers review the same code.
